text:
Nice work getting it set up, especially at 2 AM.

One correction before you rely on it: I was wrong about Maya's rows. Rows 1 and 2 have the **identical** timestamp, so the SUPERSEDED formula (column O) marks neither, and both would be kept. To break ties by keeping the lower row, replace O2 with:

```
=IF(K2="","",IF(SUMPRODUCT(($K$2:$K$421=K2)*(($I$2:$I$421>I2)+($I$2:$I$421=I2)*(ROW($I$2:$I$421)>ROW())))>0,"SUPERSEDED",""))
```

This marks an earlier row as superseded when a later or same-time duplicate sits below it, so only one copy survives.

That fix and the manual review pass can wait until tomorrow. Nothing in the sheet will break overnight, and review work goes better with fresh eyes. Get some sleep.
